attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page's head line reads «Οσιος Συαγριος (; - 787)» and its body gives two sentences. The corpus keeps no Syagrius and the sweep found no folder that folds onto the name. `abbot` is used because the page says he founded a monastery — «ίδρυσε μονή στην περιοχή της Προβηγκίας» — and `Προβηγκία` is where the English form places him; the page names Nice as the place of his repose and not of his monastery. No hymn, no relics.
